candidate_windows.window_text: Our model is implemented on the top of Huggingface's transformers (Wolf et al., 2019) and based on BART-base model<sup>7</sup>. During training, the model is fine-tuned with the AdamW optimizer (Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019) on two 32G Tesla V100 GPUs for 20 epochs. The batch size is 24 for each GPU. The learning rate linearly warms up to $3 \times 10^{-5}$ during the first 2K steps, and then decays with the cosine schedule. The hyper-parameter $\lambda$ in Eq. 10 is 0.1. During testing, we set the beam size, the threshold $\xi$ , and the threshold $\zeta$ as 50, 13, and 2. We repeat all of the experiments with three different random seeds and the average results are reported.
